arxiv-1412-1362.title: Common Coupled Fixed Point Theorems for Maps in a T 0 T_{0} -ultra-quasi-metric Space
arxiv-1412-1362.creator: Collins Amburo Agyingi
arxiv-1412-1362.description: Abstract In this article, we prove the existence of common fixed points for a pair of maps on a q q -spherically complete T 0 T_{0} -ultra-quasi-metric space. The present article is a generalization, in the assymmetric setting of the paper of Rao et al. [ 11 ] .

arxiv-1905-05897.title: Transferable Clean-Label Poisoning Attacks on Deep Neural Nets
arxiv-1905-05897.creator: Chen Zhu, W. Ronny Huang, Ali Shafahi, Hengduo Li, Gavin Taylor, Christoph Studer, Tom Goldstein
arxiv-1905-05897.description: Abstract Clean-label poisoning attacks inject innocuous looking (and “correctly” labeled) poison images into training data, causing a model to misclassify a targeted image after being trained on this data. We consider transferable poisoning attacks that succeed without access to the victim network’s outputs, architecture, or (in some cases) training data.

arxiv-2305-05902.title: Multi-stage Progressive Reasoning for Dunhuang Murals Inpainting
arxiv-2305-05902.creator: Wenjie Liu 1, Baokai Liu 1, Shiqiang Du 1,2, Yuqing Shi 3, Jiacheng Li 1, Jianhua Wang 1
arxiv-2305-05902.description: Abstract Dunhuang murals suffer from fading, breakage, surface brittleness and extensive peeling affected by prolonged environmental erosion. Image inpainting techniques are widely used in the field of digital mural inpainting. Generally speaking, for mural inpainting tasks with large area damage, it is challenging for any image inpainting method.

arxiv-2310-16328.title: The effects of Thomson scattering and chemical mixing on early-time light curves of double peaked type IIb supernovae
arxiv-2310-16328.creator: Seong Hyun Park, Sung-Chul Yoon, Sergei Blinnikov
arxiv-2310-16328.description: Abstract Previous numerical simulations of double-peaked SNe IIb light curves have demonstrated that the radius and mass of the hydrogen-rich envelope of the progenitor star can significantly influence the brightness and timescale of the early-time light curve around the first peak.

arxiv-2406-17574.title: Beyond Text-to-SQL for IoT Defense: A Comprehensive Framework for Querying and Classifying IoT Threats
arxiv-2406-17574.creator: Ryan Pavlich, Nima Ebadi, Richard Tarbell, Billy Linares, Adrian Tan, Rachael Humphreys, Jayanta Kumar Das, Rambod Ghandiparsi, Hannah Haley, Jerris George, Rocky Slavin, Kim-Kwang Raymond Choo
arxiv-2406-17574.description: Abstract Recognizing the promise of natural language interfaces to databases, prior studies have emphasized the development of text-to-SQL systems. While substantial progress has been made in this field, existing research has concentrated on generating SQL statements from text queries. The broader challenge, however, lies in inferring new information about the returned data.

arxiv-2408-04855.title: Parity Violating Marginal Deformation of the 3D Gross-Neveu-Thirring Model
arxiv-2408-04855.creator: Gordon W. Semenoff and Riley A. Stewart Department of Physics and Astronomy, University of British Columbia, 6224 Agricultural Road, Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada V6T 1Z1
arxiv-2408-04855.description: Abstract A hybrid of the critical three dimensional Gross-Neveu and Thirring models deformed by explicit parity breaking operators is studied in the large N expansion and using the renormalization group. The regime of coupling constants where the theory is stable is identified and criteria for the occurrence of fixed points in that regime are found.

arxiv-2411-19338.title: Diode effect in the Fraunhofer pattern of disordered planar Josephson junctions
arxiv-2411-19338.creator: Luca Chirolli, Angelo Greco, Alessandro Crippa, Elia Strambini, Mario Cuoco, Luigi Amico, Francesco Giazotto
arxiv-2411-19338.description: Abstract Abstract.— The Josephson diode effect describes the property of a Josephson junction to have different values of the critical current for different direction of applied bias current and it is the focus of intense research thanks to the possible applications.

arxiv-2507-18629.title: On t t -intersecting Families of Spanning Trees
arxiv-2507-18629.creator: Pitchayut Saengrungkongka
arxiv-2507-18629.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Pitchayut Saengrungkongka. We prove that there exists a constant c > 0 c>0 such that for all integers 2 ≤ t ≤ c ​ n 2\leq t\leq cn , if 𝒜 \mathcal{A} is a collection of spanning trees in K n K_{n} such that any two intersect at at least t t edges, then | 𝒜 | ≤ 2 t ​ n n − t − 2 |\mathcal{A}|\leq 2^{t}n^{n-t-2} .

arxiv-2510-03562.title: Flavor, transverse momentum, and azimuthal dependence of charged pion multiplicities in SIDIS with 10.6 GeV electrons
arxiv-2510-03562.creator: P. Bosted, H. Bhatt, S. Jia, W. Armstrong, D. Dutta, R. Ent, D. Gaskell, E. Kinney, H. Mkrtchyan, S. Ali, R. Ambrose, D. Androic, C. Ayerbe Gayoso, A. Bandari, V. arxiv-2510-03562.description: Abstract Measurements of SIDIS multiplicities for π + \pi^{+} and π − \pi^{-} from proton and deuteron targets are reported on a grid of hadron kinematic variables z z , P T P_{T} , and ϕ ∗ \phi^{*} for leptonic kinematic variables in the range 0.3 < x < 0.6 0.3<x<0.

pmc-10492276.title: Critical thinking disposition of medical students in Anhui Province, China: a cross-sectional investigation
pmc-10492276.creator: Jinxia Zhai, Haisheng Zhang
pmc-10492276.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the critical thinking disposition of medical undergraduates.MethodsThis cross-sectional study was performed on 426 students from four majors, including preventive medicine, maternal and children’s health care medicine, health inspection and quarantine, and food quality and safety. The survey was completed in May 2019 using the California Critical Thinking Dispositions Inventory-Chinese version (CTDI-CV).

pmc-10554093.title: THU646 Postmenopausal Hyperandrogenism Secondary To Ovarian Leydig Cell Tumor
pmc-10554093.creator: Jennifer Tania Batch, Gunjan Yogendra Gandhi
pmc-10554093.description: Disclosure: J.T. Batch: None. G.Y. Gandhi: None. Introduction: Hirsutism is typically the initial presentation of virilization, including male pattern balding, deepening of the voice, and clitoromegaly. Postmenopausal hyperandrogenism can originate from adrenal or ovarian causes. This report describes marked hirsutism and scalp hair loss in a patient, leading to significant negative psychological and social impacts.

pmc-10643830.title: Developing a prediction model of career plateau for nurses: A cross‐sectional study
pmc-10643830.creator: Hongmei Zhu, Mingzi Li
pmc-10643830.description: AimThe study aimed to understand the current situation regarding career plateaus experienced by nurses. The objectives were to analyze factors influencing career plateau, and develop a prediction model for career plateau for nurses.DesignA cross‐sectional survey was conducted using convenience sampling.MethodsParticipants were 2680 nurses from six tertiary hospitals.

pmc-11505883.title: Indigo alleviates psoriasis through the AhR/NF-κB signaling pathway: an in vitro and in vivo study
pmc-11505883.creator: Yu Lin, Lihong Yang, Dongxiang Wang, Haiqing Lei, Yuelin Zhang, Wen Sun, Jing Liu
pmc-11505883.description: BackgroundPsoriasis is a chronic inflammatory skin disease. A strong association between the AhR/ NFκB axis and the inflammatory response in psoriasis. Indigo (IDG) has demonstrated significant anti-inflammatory properties. This study aimed to assess the anti-psoriatic efficacy of IDG while investigating the underlying mechanisms involved.MethodsIn the in vitro experiments, cell viability was assessed using the CCK-8.

pmc-11691120.title: MEASURING LIGHTING USING AN INDIVIDUAL WEARABLE LIGHT SENSOR IN NURSING HOME RESIDENTS WITH DEMENTIA
pmc-11691120.creator: Ying-Ling Jao, Julian Wang, Shevvaa Beiglary, Yo-Jen Liao
pmc-11691120.description: More research has examined the light effect in dementia. Lighting exposure varies widely across times and people. Individual light sensors allow more precise measurements. Yet, their feasibility has not been established. This study examined the feasibility of using individual light sensors (LYS Button) in a clinical trial for nursing home residents with dementia. This study enrolled 27 residents with dementia.

pmc-12359946.title: Multimodal imaging of tumour-related lipid exudation and exudative retinal detachment following brachytherapy in choroidal melanoma
pmc-12359946.creator: Elena Ros-Sanchez, David Oliver-Gutierrez, Paul Buck, Tetiana Goncharova-Simón, Marta Garrido-Marín, Miguel Ángel Zapata-Victori, Anna Boixadera
pmc-12359946.description: BackgroundChoroidal melanoma is the most common primary intraocular malignancy, accounting for 90% of all uveal melanomas. Although radiation therapy (brachytherapy, proton beam and gamma knife) is a standard and effective treatment for choroidal melanomas, it carries a risk of vision-threatening complications such as cataract, optic neuropathy, and radiation retinopathy.

pmc-12448844.title: The nuclear pore complex acts as a hub for pri-miRNA transcription and processing in plants
pmc-12448844.creator: Lucia Gonzalo, Delfina Gagliardi, Camila Zlauvinen, Tomasz Gulanicz, Agustín L Arce, Josefina Fernandez, Damian A Cambiagno, Catharina Merchante, Agnieszka Zienkiewicz, Artur Jarmolowski, Pablo A Manavella
pmc-12448844.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The regulation of miRNA biogenesis and movement is essential for plant development and environmental responses. HASTY (HST), a karyopherin protein, has been implicated in miRNA biogenesis and movement, though its role in non-cell-autonomous miRNA movement remains unclear. Through a genetic screen, we identified that mutations in the HAWAIIAN SKIRT (HWS) gene suppress the developmental defects of hst mutants by restoring miRNA movement.

pmc-12619581.title: Walking Our Way Toward COPD Prevention: From Correlation to Action
pmc-12619581.creator: Vanesa Bellou, Nikos Papadimitriou, Evangelia Ntzani
pmc-12619581.description: tion for patients at all stages of COPD.3,4 Yet a fundamental question persists: does the association between physical activity and COPD precede clinical disease manifestation? In this issue of the International Journal of COPD, Yuan et al provide a cross-sectional analysis examining the relationship between objectively measured walking patterns and COPD prevalence in the general population.

pmc-12737137.title: Dual-Branch Superpixel and Class-Center Attention Network for Efficient Semantic Segmentation
pmc-12737137.creator: Yunting Zhang, Hongbin Yu, Haonan Wang, Mengru Zhou, Tao Zhang, Yeh-Cheng Chen, Yitzhak Yitzhaky
pmc-12737137.description: With the advancement of deep learning, image semantic segmentation has achieved remarkable progress. However, the complexity and real-time requirements of practical applications pose greater challenges for segmentation algorithms. To address these, we propose a dual-branch network guided by attention mechanisms that tackles common limitations in existing methods, such as coarse edge segmentation, insufficient contextual understanding, and high computational overhead.

pmc-13016701.title: Role model narratives are underutilized in Instagram and TikTok climate action posts
pmc-13016701.creator: Julia Fine, Joshua Ettinger, Sri Saahitya Uppalapati, John Kotcher, Edward Maibach
pmc-13016701.description: Role model narratives—stories about specific people taking recommended actions—are a proven communication strategy for encouraging socially beneficial behaviors such as climate action. However, the extent to which climate activists share role model narratives on social media has yet to be investigated.

pmc-13062351.title: Intertrochanteric Femur Fracture in Severe Peripheral Vascular Disease Complicated by Acute Limb Ischemia and Amputation: A Case Report
pmc-13062351.creator: Killi Madhu Babu, Sai Surya Dinesh Pydi, Vishal Kumar, Sandeep Patel
pmc-13062351.description: Introduction:Intertrochanteric (IT) femur fractures are among the most commonly encountered injuries in orthopedic practice and are typically managed successfully with internal fixation using cephalomedullary devices. Vascular complications following such procedures are rare and are most often limited to localized arterial injury or pseudoaneurysm formation.

pmc-13337118.title: Super‐Resolution and High‐Data‐Density Acoustic Meta‐Hologram via Amplitude and Phase Coupling
pmc-13337118.creator: Xiao Guo, Xinzong Wang, Guoshen Tang, Haohan Zeng, Siqi Fan, Xinghao Hu, Youyu Mo, Zhenyu He, Tingting Li, Hui Xu, Jiao Shen, Haiyan Fan, Xiaoxiang Gao, Yifan Zhu, Hui Zhang, Badreddine Assouar

pmc-13425369.creator: Zhuoshen Lin, Wenjing Liao, Meiqian Xu, Tianlong Li, Lijuan Song, Gui Chen, Huakang Du, Guofei Feng, Zhiming Feng, Qi Zhang, Yabang Chen, Jiayi Liu, Baoxin Peng, Jianlei Xie, Xiaowen Zhang

pmc-13537008.title: Early Local Treatment Delays Multiple Metastases in Non‐Small Cell Lung Cancer With Solitary Distant Metastasis: A Multicenter Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13537008.creator: Kang Miao, Siyu Lei, Xiaobin Zheng, Shanshan Yang, Yujing Li, Sihui Chen, Qian Miao, Longfeng Zhang, Zihua Zou, Haipeng Xu, Gen Lin
pmc-13537008.description: Solitary distant metastasis (SDM) is a distinct oligometastatic subtype associated with a relatively favorable prognosis. This multicenter retrospective study including 139 non‐small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients with SDM (2019–2024) was conducted to investigate prognostic factors for multiple metastases and identify the critical time window for local treatment.

pmc-13656592.title: Platelet homeostasis and heterogeneity in inflammation and sepsis: mechanisms, biological effects, and clinical potential
pmc-13656592.creator: Yiyun Pan, Wenling Zhao, Beibei Yu, Ji Zhang, Mengdi Qu, Ruiwen Jiang, Tingye Xu, Dongliang Li, Hao Zhang, Changhong Miao
pmc-13656592.description: Sepsis is a life-threatening syndrome resulting from a dysregulated host immune response to infection and is frequently accompanied by coagulation abnormalities and multiple organ dysfunction. As central regulators at the intersection of hemostasis, inflammation, and immunity, platelets play a critical role in the initiation and progression of sepsis.
